cues: Stanza one begins by saying it twice: I became soft, I became soft, as if discovering it while speaking.
After the tumult he crashed on the eerie stillness, the frightening quiet after something terrible.
He inherited the soft, handed down by the times, when the sky grew like crocuses over stones: crocuses are small spring flowers that push up through stony ground, and they will come back.
Then the governing paradox: softness rose like a gale, tearing my roofs.
And the night speaks only the public language of posters and politics, rituals and reasons.
text: Stanza one begins by saying it twice: I became soft, I became soft, as if discovering it while speaking. Why? After the tumult he crashed on the eerie stillness, the frightening quiet after something terrible. He inherited the soft, handed down by the times, when the sky grew like crocuses over stones: crocuses are small spring flowers that push up through stony ground, and they will come back. Then the governing paradox: softness rose like a gale, tearing my roofs. Softness behaves like a storm. And the night speaks only the public language of posters and politics, rituals and reasons.
